Your downloads, in order. An open-source download manager for Windows that handles direct downloads and BitTorrent in one list, and makes sure files arrive intact.

## Download

| Platform | File |
| --- | --- |
| **Windows 10 / 11** (64-bit) | [`Fetchlane_{{VERSION}}_x64-setup.exe`](https://github.com/{{REPO}}/releases/download/{{TAG}}/Fetchlane_{{VERSION}}_x64-setup.exe) |

The installer includes the browser extension for Chrome, Edge and Brave (**Settings → Browser → Show extension folder**).

## First launch

Fetchlane isn't code-signed yet, so Windows will ask you to confirm the first time: if "Windows protected your PC" appears, click **More info → Run anyway**.

Full steps, the browser extension, updating and uninstalling: [installation guide](https://github.com/{{REPO}}/blob/{{TAG}}/docs/INSTALL.md) · New to Fetchlane? Read the [user guide](https://github.com/{{REPO}}/blob/{{TAG}}/docs/USER_GUIDE.md).

## What's in this release

See the [changelog](https://github.com/{{REPO}}/blob/{{TAG}}/CHANGELOG.md).

## Good to know

- Early preview: built for Windows 10 and 11, tested on Windows 10 so far. See [project status](https://github.com/{{REPO}}/blob/{{TAG}}/docs/PROJECT_STATUS.md) for what's verified and known limitations.
- No account and no telemetry. Fetchlane only connects to the servers of the downloads you add and, for torrents, to trackers, the DHT network and peers.
- Links from your browser or Windows always open **Add download** for you to confirm.
- Verify your download with `SHA256SUMS.txt` below.
- Found a problem? [Report it](https://github.com/{{REPO}}/issues/new/choose).
- Fetchlane is free. If it helps you, you can [buy me a coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/longitude) ☕
